newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks seen opening weaker.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks seen opening weaker.

text.p: * Toronto stocks were seen opening weaker on Wednesday after Tuesday's rally, as longer term bearish sentiment took over. * Eye on more quarterly corporate earnings.
Toronto stocks were forecast to open weaker on Wednesday after a one percent gain on Tuesday, unable to sustain their lofty levels as investors looked past stronger earnings to leaner times ahead.
"The TSE (Toronto Stock Exchange) does not look particularly healthy in here," one equities trader said. On Tuesday, Toronto's key 300 Composite Index jumped 57.72 points to 5855.37.
The trader said stellar first-quarter earnings would give way to lower profits in the second quarter amid higher U.S. interest rates.
